system.description: When you get in someone's face threatening violence and you intend to carry through, roll Edge.

success.value: NPCs do what you want. PCs choose: do what you want, or suffer the established consequences.

partial.value:
For NPCs, the MC chooses 1:
• they attempt to remove you as a threat, but not before suffering the established consequences
• they do it, but they want payback. Add them as a Threat
• they do it, but tell someone all about it. Advance the appropriate Mission Clock

PCs choose: do what you want, or suffer the established consequences. They gain +1 forward to act against you.
